scriptsInfo.db:start: Start the local Supabase Docker services. Run this before local development.
scriptsInfo.db:stop: Stop the local Supabase services while preserving local database data.
scriptsInfo.db:migrate: Apply pending migration files to local Supabase without deleting existing local data.
scriptsInfo.db:migrate:remote: Apply pending migration files to the hosted Supabase project configured in .env.
scriptsInfo.db:reset: Delete local database data, then rebuild it from all migrations and supabase/seed.sql.
scriptsInfo.db:test: Run the SQL database tests in supabase/tests against local Supabase.
scriptsInfo.db:types: Regenerate src/lib/supabase/database.types.ts from the local database schema.
